basis.adopted_from: FedRAMP CR26 KSI catalog (launched 2026-06-24; 46 KSIs / 10 families)
basis.melds: NIST SP 800-171r2 (110 reqs / 320 AOs) + 800-171r3 (97 reqs / 509 DS, 88 ODP-linked)
basis.levels: CMMC L1/L2/L3 untouched; classes set proof depth only

invariants: 800-171 remains the requirement floor at every class
FIPS-validated cryptography required for CUI (KSI-CUI-ENC); CMVP status continuously checked
DFARS 252.204-7012(b)-(m) obligations attach at every class
FedRAMP Moderate / Class C equivalency for CSPs retained per DoD CIO memo Dec 21 2023
A KSI is MET only when ALL mapped AOs/DS are demonstrated by required evidence types; per-AO status retained in the SDR (Security Decision Record)
Uplift KSIs never substitute for 171-mapped KSIs

POA&M/exception eligibility binds at the REQUIREMENT level per 32 CFR 170.21 and the DoD scoring methodology: the exception engine refuses a clock for any AO under an ineligible requirement regardless of which KSI carries it; KSI-level non_deferrable flags are informational (crown-jewel families), not the enforcement mechanism
Uplift KSIs are never required below Class D and never affect level compliance; they are scored transparency, present for CR26/Class-C reciprocity and resilience visibility

Revision indifference: KSI statements are stable; assessable baselines (171r2/171r3/172-2021/172r3) swap underneath via revision_profiles and per-KSI mapping fields; 172r3+172Ar3 (final May 2026) enter as the L3 forward baseline with NIST-native OSCAL as the machine source

evidence_types.E1: Machine telemetry (API/config query of live state)
evidence_types.E2: Provenanced artifact (signed, hash-chained, timestamped; third-party-originated preferred)
evidence_types.E3: Bound intent (thin policy bound to enforcing configuration)

A.automatable_ksi: MAY automate; E3 bound intent + signed attestation
A.assessment: automated package validation; no assessor hours

B.automatable_ksi: SHOULD automate; >=1 automated method (E1) + 1 other type

C.applies: L2 C3PAO natural; CUI floor (= FedRAMP Class C)
C.automatable_ksi: MUST automate; >=2 independent automated methods (E1 x2, distinct sources) + E3
C.physical_ksi: >=2 non-machine types (E2+E4/E5); E2 third-party-originated where one exists
C.assessment: pipeline-integrity verification + per-KSI sampling + Tier-3 floor walk

D.automatable_ksi: MUST automate; >=4 methods incl. 1 adversarial E5
D.physical_ksi: >=3 types incl. exercised E5 + in-person E4

asset_rules.CUI: full KSI set at contract class
asset_rules.SPA: full set for protection functions provided
asset_rules.SPECIALIZED: fixed archetype E2 artifact set; no telemetry demanded
asset_rules.OOS: must be shown separated via SCB-DFD

exception_semantics.eligibility: requirement-level per 32 CFR 170.21 (ineligible requirements cannot be clocked; today's 180-day POA&M window governs until rule amendment)

changelog: 0.1.4 (2026-07-16): SSR renamed SDR (Security Decision Record), adopting FedRAMP CR26's SSP-successor term for one artifact language across programs; artifact-disposition, evidence-storage/CUI-handling, audience-disclosure, and levels-vs-classes rationale content added to both HTML artifacts
0.1.3 (2026-07-15): requirement-level Rev3 mappings shipped per KSI (renumber + verified absorptions + new PL/SA/SR families); AO math reconciled (509 DS = ~421 AOs + 88 ODP)
0.1.2 (2026-07-15): revision_profiles added for 171r2/171r3/172(2021)/172r3; APT module dual-rev mappings; 172Ar3 (final 2026-05-13) integrated as engine source

0.1.1 (2026-07-15): red-team fixes — uplift class-gated below D; CR26 B-optional conditionality restored for 5 KSIs; per-KSI level applicability added; non-deferrability moved to requirement level; IAM-APM aligned to 3.5.3 floor; SCB-DFD carries SSR completeness check; exception semantics added
